title: schur-numbers
abstract: Lean 4 formalization of modular Schur numbers. For m ≥ 2 and ℓ ≥ 2, put n = m/gcd(m,ℓ-1). The main result proves the uniform closed form S_m(k,ℓ) = n-1 for every k ≥ n-1. The development also proves the integer-to-residue formulation and lossless N ≤ m-1 bound, singleton-safety and zero-class obstructions, the exact one-color formula for 2 ≤ ℓ ≤ m, and the stated sigma-infinity coset-cardinality bound. Mathlib-only Headline statements are checked by the Palomar Comparator configuration. A separate public 27-module hand-written, generated-independent project layer contains named canonical-cover seed count, stable-prime transport and recurrence, prime-power, and unrestricted exponent-truncation capstones; those capstones have a separate transitive-axiom audit and are outside the Comparator's statement-comparison gate. The earlier generated native_decide scan tree is excluded from the public release and verification claims.
